name: uom-converter
description: Unit-of-measure conversions for the electrical industry.

scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && wrangler deploy --config platforms/web/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.dist:store: vite build --config platforms/windows/vite.config.ts && electron-builder --config platforms/windows/electron-builder.json --win appx
scripts.android:sync: vite build --config platforms/android/vite.config.ts && cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && node platforms/android/gradle.cjs installDebug --launch
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && node platforms/android/gradle.cjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: npm run android:sync && node platforms/android/gradle.cjs bundleRelease
